messages:
Hannah (Voltique): hey team :wave: kicking off Voltique onboarding. POC: Hannah. Goals: 1) auto-summarize billing discrepancy alerts, 2) provide embeddings for operator search, 3) pilot 900 req/day and measurable cost delta. Need owners, acceptance criteria, and a compact 30/60/90 plan.

Marta (CSM): welcome Hannah 1 I’ll run CS coordination and acceptance tests. Quick Q: is finance tying renewal to cost improvements or accuracy?

Zoe (Finance): hi  renewal conversation: if pilot shows >=15% cost improvement vs current baseline and summary precision >=90%, we'll move to a paid contract. Need cost reporting hooks in the console.

Omar (Solutions Eng): I’ll lead integration. Suggest chat + structured output (tags) for summaries and embeddings for search. Please share sample billing logs and avg tokens. Also confirm region: EU-west or EU-central?

Hannah (Voltique): sample logs uploaded to s3://voltique-onboard/samples/24h.json. Avg tokens ~300 per event, occasional bursts to 1.2k events/min. EU-west preferred. Pilot go-live target: 2026-05-22.

Priya (Enablement): enablement plan: dev workshop day 1, ops runbook + alerts day 7, and a customer-facing playbook. I’ll post a pre-read with IAM roles and allowlist steps.

Eve (Security): flag: data retention and billing identifiers are sensitive. Need retention mapping and deletion-on-request policy. Marta, capture whether deletion conflicts with finance audit needs.

Marta (CSM): noted. Draft acceptance criteria: - Summary precision >=90% on gold set, - P95 latency <=650ms, - Cost per 1k tokens <= baseline * 0.85 during pilot, - Auditability + retention policy agreed, - Console cost hooks present.

Omar (Solutions Eng): proposed milestones (condensed):
Week 1: keys, allowlist, smoke test + sample curl
Week 2: ingestion pipeline + embedding index + baseline evals
Week 3: structured output (tags) + latency tuning + canary
Week 4: pilot + cost reporting + runbook handoff

Omar (Solutions Eng): smoke curl: `curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer <KEY>\" -d '{\"model\":\"rwd-chat-1\",\"input\":\"Summarize billing discrepancy for invoice 9876\"}'` 1 run from your network and confirm egress rules.

Zoe (Finance): request: add granular per-route cost breakdown to the dashboard during pilot. Will use that to validate the cost delta.

Hannah (Voltique): noted. We also need an export of per-request outputs for reconciliations (encrypted). Is VPC+KMS sufficient?

Eve (Security): initial answer: VPC + KMS likely ok but we need to map retention vs audit needs. If exports must be immutable for >1yr we may need Private eval. Marta, capture legal contact.

Priya (Enablement): pre-read checklist I’ll include: API key, allowlist IPs, sample S3 link, gold prompt set, expected token distribution. I’ll record the dev workshop.

Marta (CSM): proposing kickoff Wed 14:00 CET or Thu 09:00 CET. Who should be on the invite? (eng lead, security, finance, infra).

Hannah (Voltique): Wed 14:00 CET works. Attendees: Hannah, Marco (Eng lead), Zoe, Eve, Omar, Priya, Marta.

cal-bot: Meeting created: Wed 14:00 CET 1 "Voltique • Redwood Onboarding Kickoff". Invite sent.

Marta (CSM): CS action items: collect allowlist IPs, confirm retention mapping, request encrypted export requirements, and finalize success criteria & acceptance tests. Any other risks?

Hannah (Voltique): risk: high-cardinality billing metadata may blow up embedding index. Will provide a sampling strategy and a small extractor script.

Omar (Solutions Eng): noted  we'll prototype a dedupe+hash step in Week 1 and test index size. Also will add a cost report to the pilot dashboard.

Marta (CSM): great. I’ll post the action tracker and the pre-read link to the invite. See you Wed. :rocket:
